primary_hypothesis: Frozen sound-event CLAP adds complementary information to Gemma semantics for structured preferred-span ranking. Omitted material is not labeled unacceptable.

cohort.sampling: Exact preexisting dense20s absolute offsets including original-end-aligned final window; no target-dependent sampling. Five incomplete-original tails excluded identically.

recipe.source: Verified neutral mono16k SSD FLACs only; size/mtime/SHA and actual samplerate/channels/frames before reading. Original source fingerprint carried without stat or original reads.
recipe.decode: SoundFile seek/read exactly320000 finite samples; truncated inputs rejected without padding; no FFmpeg
recipe.halves: Split deterministic first480000/last480000 samples, each10s at48k; no random crop or fusion. Exactly model input length.
recipe.pooling: Normalize each512-dimensional half vector, equal mean, normalize final512 vector
recipe.limitation: Existing16k mono stages omit original frequencies above8kHz and stereo cues. Upsampling does not restore either.

outputs.privacy: Numeric vectors, pseudonymous row/group, numeric ranges and SHA/fingerprints only; no source paths/video IDs/transcripts/raw temp audio. Files0600/directories0700.
outputs.checkpoint: Atomic after each two20s windows; prefix offsets/decoded/resampled/half sample counts; planned offsets; complete flag; exact model/recipe/receipt/stage/source/original-range identity. Partial checkpoints excluded from primary evaluation.

resources.includes: Imports, waiting, stage/hash checks, model load, synthetic inference, benchmark, full extraction and numeric checkpoint writes. External process deadline required by root.
resources.idle_guard: Existing media-worker guard before load and each batch; initial GPU idle guard. No competing FFmpeg or GPU job.
resources.synthetic: Generated440Hz tone20s; repeat deterministic unit512 inference before private reads.
resources.throughput: First8 label-independent private windows checkpointed once. Continue only if1.5×measured per-window walltime×remaining windows+30s reserve fits original deadline. No extensions/retries.
resources.downloads: None in extractor. Separately authorized public pinned weights+config metadata only after reviewer pin/SHA/size/disk check; no credentials/media uploads/cloud.

cpu_comparison.primary: Existing28 pooled features +trainfold-only CLAP PCA16 =44 features, fixedC1 symmetric original-balanced structured gold-vs64 label-independent alternative spans.
cpu_comparison.control: Exact same44 dimensions and cohort: existing28 +16 zero components; no new model/family/C grid.
cpu_comparison.transforms: All PCA/scaling fit only inner/outer training originals. Existing exact structured interval grid/pooling/weights/ties unchanged; heldout candidate edges never use gold.
cpu_comparison.folds: 5 outer and3 inner whole-channel folds; identity versus argmax policy selected only on inner folds; unseen original fallback unchanged.
cpu_comparison.gates: Mean IoU>identity+.02; retained gold duration>=.97; p10>=.9; at least3 clips shortened>=5s;5000 paired-channel bootstrap gain lower>0 and retention lower>=.97; matched control gain lower>0; exact zero-mass diagnostic unchanged.
